historical_record.description: The Recreation Commission awarded one $842,000 contract to Carrico & Gautier to build four recreation centers: Potrero Hill, Ocean View, St. Mary's and Sunset.
Sunset Playground, 28th Avenue and Lawton Street, was dedicated, according to the official list of 1947 recreation bond playgrounds the Recreation and Park Commission entered in its minutes.
The Recreation Commission heard that the convenience station at Sunset Playground, designed by architect William G. Merchant, was finished, and thanked him for his work on it.
